name: San Mauro Torinese (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Mauro Torinese (a tower on red, crowned, within olive and oak branches).
history: Municipal flag of San Mauro Torinese, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Mauro Torinese arms — a tower on red, crowned, within olive and oak branches
